gingiris-seo-geo-agent 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Launches a comprehensive, automated SOP for daily SEO and GEO agent execution.
- Features a 4-phase audit automation, GSC data pipeline, AI-powered traffic tracking, schema validation, and IndexNow integration.
- Provides week-by-week operational timeline (zero to ~32K impressions in one month).
- Includes ready-to-use templates: daily SEO report, keyword-to-landing-page mapping, CTA conversion blocks, and core agent rulebook.
- Designed for hands-off, agent-driven workflows validated on real content sites; includes tool recommendations and owner checklist.
